programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Rico og Ja'Mari
programme.desc: Amr. dokumentarserie

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Artis & Jess
programme.desc: Tidligere deltagere fra Catfish: The TV Show sæson to tager plads i MTVs studie på Times Square for at besvare seernes nysgerrige spørgsmål.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Jamey & Ari
programme.desc: Efter et tre år langt internetforhold, er Tiana flyttet til den til anden side af USA for sin store kærlighed, James.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Brandon og McKenna
programme.desc: Brandon elsker McKenna, men han har ikke fået kontakt i virkeligheden og overvejer, om McKenna er ægte.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: Spencer afslører en hemmelighed for Nev og Max, som han har holdt for sig selv i seks år. Han har et forhold til en af verdens største popstjerner.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta: Brager ind som en supernova
programme.desc: Der er ny stjerneglans i ATL, da gruppen lærer familien Nova at kende. Kirk træffer en beslutning, der kan give familien Frost fuldt hus.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: What is the Gardener Doing Here?
programme.desc: Kori beder Tami om hjælp for at se, om kæresten George er utro, men alt forandrer sig, da Tami indser, at hun selv er involveret.

programme.title: Ghosted: Love Gone Missing: Ross & Jordan
programme.desc: Som standup-komiker i Brooklyn kunne Ross ikke tro sit eget held, da han begyndte at date sin drømmepige, Jordan.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Der er en, der stikker af
programme.desc: Nia og hendes mor, Aida, er nervøse for Nias kommende bryllup. Men Nia mistænker, at William gør mere end bare husbesøg.

programme.title: The Challenge All Stars: På stjernejagt
programme.desc: De sidste fire par konkurrerer i den sidste challenge. Et livsforandrende beløb står på spil. og nogle af parrene falder tilbage i gamle rutiner.

programme.title: Ink Master: Tilbage til tegnebrættet
programme.desc: Kampen om en salon fortsætter, da deltagerne tatoverer dyr fra hjembyen. Nogle må tilbage til tegnebrættet, og slaget er kun lige begyndt.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Karrueche Tran LVII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness imponeres Rob, Steelo og gæst Karrueche Tran af nogleEkstremgamle, nægter at spise ved bordet.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Karrueche Tran LVI
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness disker Rob, Steelo og Karrueche Tran op med nogle smidige kiksere i Køkkengymnaster.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Karrueche Tran LIX
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness banker Rob, Steelo og Karrueche Tran sig gennem gipsplader i Spartlingstid.

programme.title: MTV Unplugged: Chris Isaak: Unplugged
programme.desc: Optaget i Sony Musik Studios i New York i sommeren 1995. Isaak optræder med materiale fra sin seneste udgivelse, "Forever Blue.

programme.title: Ink Master Redemption: Gør regnskabet op
programme.desc: Rivaliserende artister designer i en direkte konfrontation for at stille utilfredse lærreder tilfreds, men kun én kan få oprejsning. Josh Hibbard.

programme.title: Ink Master: Synk eller svæv
programme.desc: De tilbageværende kunstnere arbejder i par for at udføre store rygstykker, der tester både tekstur og deltagernes nerver.

programme.title: Ink Master: Ink Master: Revenge
programme.desc: Konkurrencen er mere intens end nogensinde med kun seks kunstnere tilbage. Alliancer sættes på prøve, da de tilbageværende tatoverer i hold af tre.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood CXVIII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness svinger Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood sig i VILDE RANKER, hepper på SKRALDEKRIGERE og tager ud på løjperne i HOP UD AF SKI.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood CXIX
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness ser Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Lolo Wood nogle dårlige entréer i KOMMER IND SKIDT.

programme.title: The Challenge All Stars: På stjernejagt
programme.desc: De sidste fire par konkurrerer i den sidste challenge. Et livsforandrende beløb står på spil. og nogle af parrene falder tilbage i gamle rutiner.

programme.title: Celeb Ex In The City: Malique Thompson-Dwyer and Jess Gale
programme.desc: Singlekendisser leder efter kærlighed, men det er en første date som ingen anden! Malique Thompson-Dwyer og hans date hygger sig.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Hot Single Summer: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: Marty og Chloe går på date. Louis kan ikke holde munden lukket, og der kommer en chokerende besked før den store bytur.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood LXIV
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness bliver Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood fanget i FAREZONEN, samler GLASBRAS op og ser på biler i FJERNSTYRET RASERI.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood LXVII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness banker Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood løs med hovederne i HOVEDKRAFTSTØD.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood LXX
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness møder Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood nogle farlige saltoer i SALTO-BEVIDSTHED.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood LXXII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness lider Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood af KONCERTFORVIRRING.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood LXXIII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness får Rob, Steelo og gæstevært Lolo Wood knobs under flytningen i ØMME FLYTTEFOLK, møder nogle nye kolleger.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood LXXIV
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness hopper Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Lolo Wood dive på hovedet i græsset i SPIS GRÆS.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood LXXVII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness ser Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood på konsekvenserne af ikke at se skilte i SKILTEBLIND.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood LXXVIII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness ser Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood nogle cyklister få en ubehagelig overraskelse i UVENTEDE CYKELHINDRINGER.

programme.title: Teen Mom Family Reunion: En linje i sandet.
programme.desc: Hemmeligheder afsløres i dr. Mikes workshop. Cory indser, at Taylor måske ikke er klar til at blive gift. Briana.

programme.title: Teen Mom Family Reunion: Tiden er gået
programme.desc: Briana er alvorlig hvad angår at finde kærligheden. Kayla og Ryan fortæller, om de vil beholde babyen. Cate og Ty er på en romantisk date.

programme.title: Teen Mom Family Reunion: Farvel ved bålet
programme.desc: Chey og Zach fejrer etårsjubilæum og Sean overrasker Jade ved at gøre noget uden for hans konfortzone. Gruppen tager en sidste bådtur i Columbia.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Caught In The Act: Utro
programme.desc: Tracy troede, hun havde fundet sin soulmate i musikproducer McKinley. Men efter to år begynder hun at mistænke, at han er hende utro.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Han vil være sammen, bare ikke med mig.
programme.desc: Tre uger efter, at Naima and David mødte hinanden på nettet, er de uadskillelige. Men et år efter mistænker Naima.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Krydsede du den bro?
programme.desc: Efter syv år sammen overvejer Marlo at gifte sig med kæresten Corey. Men nu mistænker Marlo, at Corey er utro og vil konfrontere ham.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta: Fjenden står for porten
programme.desc: Bambi og Sierra reparerer deres søsterlige bånd. Zane forsøger at gøre det godt igen med sin kone, men Ashley er interesseret i noget andet.

programme.title: Ink Master: Den, der kaster den første sten
programme.desc: Med kun fem shops tilbage intensiveres kampen om $200.000 og Master Shop-titlen.

programme.title: Ink Master: Maraton til finalen
programme.desc: De fire bedste shops udkæmper et tatoveringsmaraton om de tre pladser i livefinalen.

programme.title: Ink Master Redemption: Redemption: Er du en mester?
programme.desc: Tatovørerne fra de første sæsoner, Bili Vegas og Mark Matthews, er tilbage for at bevise, at de er modnet som tatovører og mennesker. Presset er stort, da deres vrede lærreder er tilbage med rasende nære og kære.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Lawrence og Cierra
programme.desc: Lawrence har været døden nær flere gange, men overlevede hver gang med forsikringen om Cierras netkærlighed. Men Cierra brænder Lawrence af.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Mary og Adam
programme.desc: En tidligere catfish beder Nev og Max om hjælp, da hun bliver vildt forelsket i en på nettet. Kan det tænktes, at catfishen snører Nev og Max...

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Jacob & Stephanie
programme.desc: Jacob lyser op, da Stephanie kommer ind i hans livestream, men er det for godt til at være sandt.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Jasmine & Ryan
programme.desc: Jasmines liv bliver bedre, da hun møder Ryan, som virker perfekt, men aldrig dukker op.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Tee & Ibraheem
programme.desc: Ibraheem får en halstatovering med Tees navn, men hun løj om sit navn, da de mødtes første gang.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta
programme.desc: Med elskede OG'er og nye hitlistetoppende artister er gruppen viklet godt ind i hinandens penge-moves og uundgåelige rod. Kan ATL genforenes i en tid.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Hun har to mobiler!
programme.desc: Richard, komiker og influencer, prøver at tage tingene alvorligt med Elisa, hans modelkæreste i et år. Han har haft en svær tid og frygter.

programme.title: Ghosted: Love Gone Missing: Brittany & Shay
programme.desc: Brittney og Shay var som søstre. De gik i byen sammen. De rejste sammen. Shay havde et foto af Brittney på sit natbord.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Det er min tidligere veninde
programme.desc: Joe, Lexis kæreste gennem fem år, har hjulpet hende med modelkarrieren. Men hun tror, at Joe ser en anden kvinde.

programme.title: Ink Master: Mavefornemmelse
programme.desc: I en lynudfordring maler tatovørerne med røg. Glimmertatoveringer og en uventet krølle gør Dagens Tatovering vigtigere end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Beadle er tilbage!
programme.desc: Efter små ti år genforenes Gary Beadle med familien. Det er en hyggelig genforening.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Karrueche Tran LXI
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness føler Rob, Steelo og Karrueche Tran smerten ved at blive ramt af to hjul i Menneske mod cykel.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Karrueche Tran LXII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness får Rob, Steelo og Karrueche Tran smagt på noget ost i Stor ost.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Karrueche Tran LXIII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness afgiver Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Karrueche Tran en bestilling til nogle Leveringslegender.

programme.title: MTV Unplugged: Sting: Unplugged
programme.desc: Denne 45 minutter lange akustiske optræden med den britiske superstjerne Sting blev optaget i New York i marts 1991 under intime studieforhold.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Ekspeditionen er slut for flere af deltagerne – men efterspillet er kun lige begyndt. I Robinson EXIT følger vi deltagerne tæt, når de vender tilbage til virkeligheden.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: En ny epoke i Ekspeditionen nærmer sig, og hold syd kæmper for at opnå en sejr, inden holdene opløses.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Det er tid til sammenlægning, men først skal deltagerne igennem et skæbnesvangert Øråd, hvor intet er som det plejer. Bølgerne går højt, når endnu en deltager må forlade ekspeditionen.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Pete og Alexandra er havnet i midten af to alliancer, og de står overfor en stor beslutning. Der skal bekendes kulør, og endnu en overlever får slukket deres drøm.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Jakob Kjeldbjerg åbner Robinson Ekspeditionen med kompromisløs autoritet, når deltagerne fra start skal træffe svære fravalg af hinanden inden den første holdkonkurrence.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Efter blot få dage på stranden skal det tabende hold i Dysten beslutte, hvem der bliver den første til at forlade Robinson Ekspeditionen 2026.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Overleverne skal endnu engang træffe svære fravalg, når en fra hvert hold sendes til Forhandling. Forhandlingen får store konsekvenser for to af Ekspeditionens deltagere.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 704
programme.desc: Gutterne tager til det eksotiske Sommarøy uden for Tromsø for at forvandle en gammel lade til et smukt feriehus. Halvor laver lamper af stråhatte, og Ole og Torkel bruger tømmeret fra den gamle lade på en kreativ måde.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 705
programme.desc: Gutternes næste eventyr fører dem til Halvors hjemegn Nevlunghavn. Her har et ungt par arvet familiens sommerhus, og de ønsker en moderne og mere personlig stil.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 706
programme.desc: Oppe i bjergene med en fantastisk udsigt over Glomfjord finder vi Glomfjord Alpinsenters hytte. Træhytten trænger desperat til lidt kærlighed, så gutterne pakker deres ski og går igang.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 707
programme.desc: I Rennebu ligger der en gård med en gammel bjælkehytte, der ligner et feriehus i Caribien. Fyrene ønsker at finde husets sjæl og må tænke kreativt for at opnå den ultimative kombination af moderne og traditionelt.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 708
programme.desc: Fra stuevinduet ser du lige op mod Gaustatoppen. Gutterne installerer større vinduer, men sørger også for at hytten er hyggelig og tæt på naturen. En overraskelse til faren venter i annekset.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 801
programme.desc: Vi tager en tur til det smukke Orre på Jæren uden for Stavanger. Torkel bygger et smart læskur til blæsende dage, og Ole og Halvor får en sjov idé med at flette terracottafliser ind i trægulvet.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 802
programme.desc: Mændene tager til Ytre Fure på Stadlandet for at lave en gammel schweizervilla om til et idyllisk og praktisk sommerhus. Halvor lærer Ole at tapetsere, og Ole har spændende planer for den gamle lade.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 803
programme.desc: Urke er en lille landsby ved siden af Hjørundfjorden. Her ligger programmets første A-formede hytte. Der skal bl.a. bygges en glasboks med store vinduer til den nye spisestue og laves ovenlysvinduer.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 804
programme.desc: Mændene rejser for første gang til Finnmark, nærmere bestemt Bugøynes. Hytten sammenlignes med "huset på prærien", og ord som "wild west" og "Ralph Lauren" bruges til at beskrive den ønskede stil.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 805
programme.desc: Lige uden for Halden ligger et sted kaldet Aremark, og her giver et ungt par Halvor frie tøjler til at renovere deres skovhytte. Torkel fælder et træ, som bliver lavet om til både bænk, bord og kunst.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 806
programme.desc: Dette års vinterhytte har udsigt over Vågå og er en typisk 80'er fyrretræshytte. Hytten er klar til at blive renoveret, og Halvor viser, hvordan man kan genbruge gamle vinduer og give møbler nyt liv.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 901
programme.desc: Sæsonens første afsnit tager os med til smukke Rott i Tananger. Her er et gammelt "jærhus" ved at blive renoveret. Der bliver bl.a. ændret i grundplanen, og Ole bygger et hyggeligt udhus.

programme.desc: As Jane seeks to ban a dietary supplement that killed a teenage football player, Kim fights to save the job of a bailiff who stopped her from being mugged while dressed as a superhero.

programme.desc: Kris joins mysterious Bianca Blake in diving to look for wrecked ships. They find "The Starshine," a ship that sunk with a load of marijuana aboard -- but fail to notice that they are being observed by Claude and Walrus.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are in Honolulu (hoping for two weeks of sun, surf and no assignments) when they receive a call from Charlie advising that Congressman Knight's son, David, honeymooning with his wife, Marti, has been attacked while moonlight picnicking on the beach.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Steve Moss, owner of the Tropicana nightclub in Honolulu, is kidnapped, after firing young dancer, Donna Lindsey. He is taken in a van to a warehouse, where he is put into a cage with 60's rock music blaring in his ears.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are sent to Moonshine country in the Deep South to investigate problems between long-feuding bootlegging families, the Bartletts and the Catlins. Son, Bobby Dan Bartlett, who is injured trying to get a shipment of whiskey to market and Catlin daughter, Melinda, are in love, much to the displeasure of both families.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Part 1 - Kelly and Kris pose as models and secure jobs with the Woodman Agency after the disappearance and subsequent death of model Jody Mills. They are joined by Julie Rogers, who, they later find out, is an undercover police officer working with partner Harry.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are hired by Barbara Stone and her sister, Jane, to track down John Thornwood. He has swindled them out of $100,000 by promising to marry Jane and persuading her to invest money in a phony South American oil exploration venture.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are called in to investigate, when Tom Archer, who owns a cab company with his wife Laurie, is badly burned as his cab explodes. Laurie Archer reveals that they have been getting threatening phone calls and someone obviously is trying to put them out of business.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Mary and her very attractive friend, Lois, go to the Hot Line Club, a singles club with a phone at each table. The phone rings and the caller asks to speak to Lois. He then tells her that she is so pretty he has to kill her.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: After an argument, Gladys Kravitz locks her husband out of their home. The Stephens invite Abner to spend the night at their place. Later, when it appears that Abner, using all his privileges as a guest, is more than satisfied with the arrangements and is making no effort to return to his own home, Darrin demands that Samantha take action. Not only is Samantha unsuccessful in all her attempts to effect a reconciliation, but she learns that Gladys wants a divorce. When all else fails, Samantha gets the idea of using sleep therapy to reunite the Kravitzes. Feeling that one of the happiest days of her life is the day a man proposes marriage, and a woman accepts him, Samantha projects Gladys and Abner in their dreams back to that day. Then she awakens them and each begins looking for the other. Later, as Samantha and Darrin look forward to spending an evening at home alone, the Kravitzes arrive to celebrate their reunion.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: As Darrin naps in the living room, Endora points out some of the unfortunate details of his face. Samantha at first protests when her mother, using witchcraft, changes Darrin's looks but then adds some touches of her own. Awakening, Darrin demands an explanation. Samantha can't explain why she and Endora were changing his features, and Darrin begins to worry. As the obsession grows, Samantha decides to build up her husband's ego. Changing her own personality, Samantha becomes a French sculptress, Michelle. She tells Darrin his face exudes the masculine appeal she has always tried to find in a model. Darrin turns down Michelle's request that he pose for her, suspecting that she is Samantha. A substitute secretary, Barbara Lucas, appears at the office and Darrin, thinking it is another of Samantha's tricks, makes a play for her, just as Samantha walks in. Her jealous reaction convinces Darrin that Samantha really loves him. Darrin explains be thought she was posing as Barbara, but leaves Samantha with an uncertain feeling.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: In every way, Samantha and Darrin Stephens are a perfectly normal, all-American couple, except for one small detail...Samantha's a witch!

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha and Endora discover the culinary delights of Mario's restaurant. Mario tells them he is going broke because he refuses to sell pizza. Samantha learns that Darrin's agency has a new client, Linton Baldwin, the owner of a large chain of pizza parlors. When Samantha uses witchcraft to get a huge newspaper ad for Mario, and Endora inserts a plug for him on Baldwin's TV program, Baldwin tells Larry Tate he is cancelling his account and signing with the agency handling Mario's restaurant. Realizing Darrin's career is in jeopardy, Samantha persuades Endora to help save the Baldwin account for Darrin. They lay out a spectacular advertising campaign for Baldwin and give the credit to Darrin's agency. Not only does Baldwin ask Darrin's agency to keep his account, but Mario's restaurant becomes a great success.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Almost as determined as Endora to break up Samantha's marriage to a mere mortal, Samantha's cousin Edgar, an elf, begins playing pranks on Darrin. Darrin's agency has been trying to hold onto the Shelley Shoe account. Edgar, invisible to all, plagues Darrin in his office. Darrin is sure Endora is working on him again, and has difficulty persuading Larry Tate to let him present the new campaign to Mr. Shelley. At the sales meeting, Fred Schulwiler, as unscrupulous competitor, almost gets the account when he makes it appear that Darrin is trying to make Mr. Shelley look ridiculous. When Samantha convinces Edgar that she is very happy with Darrin, he switches his attentions to Schulwiler. Before Edgar is through, Schulwiler has lost all chance of landing the Shelley account. Darrin, coming up with an advertising campaign featuring an elf not unlike Edgar, ties up the account for his firm.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha's Aunt Clara arrives on the Stephens' first anniversary with presents for Samantha and Darrin. Casting a spell to adjust a checkered cap she has given Darrin, Aunt Clara uses the wrong words and turns Darrin into a chimpanzee. Unable to remember how to remove the spell, Aunt Clara goes home to look for the formula. When Samantha leaves the house, Endora stays with Darrin. Darrin leaps out of a window and runs into Gladys Kravitz. She takes the chimp back to her house. Soon after, Aunt Clara comes with her book of magic, Samantha returns. Samantha tells Aunt Clara she must find Darrin since her doctor has told her she is going to have a baby. Meanwhile, Gladys and Abner have turned Darrin over to the zoo, where he is caged with three other chimps. Samantha goes to the zoo. Then Aunt Clam arrives and turns Darrin back to his former self. Samantha is finally able to tell him he is to be a father. Later, Gladys begins telling the Stephens about the chimpanzee. Suddenly realizing that Darrin is wearing the same outfit as the chimp, Gladys streaks back to her own house.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Learning that he is about to become a father, Darrin waits on Samantha hand and foot. Then Larry Tate convinces him that all women would make a career out of having a baby if you allowed them to. He gives Darrin a book on the subject which states that the more active the mother, the happier she will be, and the healthier the child. Darrin returns home completely convinced. Endora is infuriated when she hears Darrin ordering Samantha to do chores around the house. The following day, Darrin wakes up with a backache. At an office lunch, he fights for extra pickles. When Samantha learns of this, she faces up to her mother. Endora admits she has cast a spell over Darrin, but will do nothing to change the situation for the present. Darrin, dis-cussing his plight at a bar, becomes obsessed with the idea that he is going to have a baby himself. Finally, Endora removes the spell and Darrin becomes completely attentive to Samantha once more. She agrees with Darrin's assertion that he is one man in a million who knows just how she feels.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: We'Re In For A Bad Spell
programme.desc: When strange things begin happening to Adam Newlarkin, a friend of Darrin's, Aunt Clara tells Samantha he has inherited the spell placed by a witch on his ancestor who was a judge in Salem two hundred years before. Aunt Clara adds that unless Adam follows the antidote for the spell strictly, he will be branded a thief. The Stephens learn that Adam has been hired by a local bank. Samantha and Darrin manage to get Adam to kiss a dog, the first step. With Aunt Clara's help, Darrin dunks Adam in a pool three times. They have trouble persuading him to ride through town shouting praise of witches, which is the final step. However, finding his briefcase stuffed with money , Adam, a true native of Salem, believes he is under a spell. He mounts a horse and starts riding. Bank manager Abercrombie and a detective, having discovered the loss of seventy five thousand dollars, come to the Stephens' home. Aunt Clara makes the money disappear from the briefcase. Abercrombie apologizes to Adam after learning that a bank employee has been taken into custody with the stolen cash.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Phoning from London, the Tates inform the Stephens that their governess has been taken ill. They ask Darrin and Samantha to care for the child until they return. Gladys Kravitz sees them leaving the house and returning with a baby. Assuming the Stephens' baby has arrived, Gladys congratulates Maurice, Samantha's father, on the birth of his grandson. Maurice is shocked to find the baby is not being taught witchcraft. He flies away with the child to the Warlock's Club in London. Meanwhile, the Tates arrive at the local airport. Darrin tries to stall while Samantha finds their baby. In London, after many tests, the Warlocks tell Maurice the baby "hasn't got it." Nanny Witch adds that the baby is a mortal like the father. At the Stephens home, Samantha and Darrin are about to tell the Tates their baby is missing, when Maurice arrives with the child. Maurice's pride is restored when Samantha tells him her baby is not due for several months. Arriving with a present, Gladys is told to wait until Samantha's baby is born. Before vanishing through a wall, Maurice hands Gladys a martini. Watching Gladys down it, Samantha hopes she will not remember what she has seen and heard.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha arranges a meeting between Darrin and her mother which she hopes will settle their differences. A series of minor accidents sets Darrin and Endora accusing each other of being practical pokers. Realizing someone else is responsible, Samantha uncovers a serving dish and reveals her Uncle Arthur, who dotes on practical jokes. Infuriated by Darrin's uproarious appreciation of Uncle Arthur, Endora plants a Beatles hairdo on Darrin. Darrin refuses Uncle Arthur's offer to teach him some magic so he can stand up to Endora, until he is knocked out by an accident in the office. Certain Endora is at work, Darrin accepts Uncle Arthur's offer. Following Uncle Arthur's weird instructions, Darrin tries to make Endora disappear. When she does not, Darrin realizes he has been the victim of another of Uncle Arthur's pranks. Samantha enlists Endora and Darrin in a plan to cure Uncle Arthur. Arthur is incredulous when Darrin says he can turn Endora into a parrot. When Endora becomes a parrot (through her own witchcraft), Arthur pleads with Darrin to remove the spell. Endora then returns to normal and demands that Arthur stop his practical jokes, which Uncle Arthur accepts. Before leaving, Uncle Arthur gives Endora a pair of opera glasses. When she lowers them she has two black eyes.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Take Two Aspirins And Half A Pint Of Porpoise Milk
programme.desc: While Howard Norton shows the Stephens a black Peruvian rose, Samantha tells Darrin she feels ill and has lost her witchcraft. The doctor tells Samantha that her health is perfect. Gladys sees the doctor's car and brings some chicken soup. When square green spots appear on Samantha's face, Abner is sure the chicken soup is responsible. Aunt Clara arrives and lists the ingredients for a remedy. Darrin buys all the ingre-dients, except an ostrich feather, from Mr. Trigby, who caters to witches. Trying to take the ostrich feather from a woman's hat, Darrin is arrested but later released. Aunt Clara, after using witchcraft to produce an ostrich, tells Darrin she still needs four petals from a black Peruvian rose. Darrin is arrested when he tries to steal the petals from Mr. Norton's precious bloom. Finally, Aunt Clara concocts the remedy and cures Samantha. Later, Mr. Norton is astonished when he sees a window box filled with black Peruvian roses Samantha has produced by twitching her nose.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Despite Endora's demand that Samantha accompany her to a witches celebration of Halloween, Darrin insists that his wife stay at home to entertain Louise and Larry Tate, Jack Rogers, a client, and his wife, Phyllis. Disguising herself as a child in a gypsy costume, Endora hexes Darrin with a spell that will gradually turn him into a werewolf. When Samantha demands that her mother remove the spell, Endora tells her she can't remember the words. After the guests arrive, Darrin is forced to go out of the room from time to time to shave off the werewolf hair which is beginning to grow all over him. Finally, when dinner arrives, Darrin starts snarling and jumps through as open window. Larry and Jack, sure that Darrin is in werewolf costume, bring him back into the house. Darrin, fearful of what he might do, gets Samantha to lock him in the call closet. Endora reappears in a high fashion evening gown. When Samantha tells her she is behaving exactly like the stereotype of a witch she hates so much, Endora returns Darrin to his normal self. Later, Jack, certain that Endora is also garbed for Halloween, compliments her on her bizarre outfit. Endora gestures, and a lion's tail appears on Jack. Endora tells Darrin Jack won't notice it until he tries to remove his trousers.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Larry Tate invites Samantha and Darrin to a buffet for prospective client Charles Barlow. When they complain about the condition of their clothes, Aunt Clara uses magic to produce a dress for Samantha and a new suit for Darrin, who invites her along to the affair. Once there, Aunt Clara removes a fire hydrant so Darrin can park. At the party, Samantha's dress begins to vanish and Aunt Clara's other magical efforts begin to disintegrate. Agreeing to drop Barlow at his hotel, Darrin finds the hydrant has returned to its place beside the car. As a policeman approaches, Darrin's outer garments disappear. Aunt Clara's efforts to help result in chaos, with Barlow, Darrin and the policeman dressed in each other's clothing. Barlow leaves, vowing Darrin will never get his account, and still in his underwear, Darrin is jailed with Montague, an alcoholic. After Aunt Clara's attempts to clothe Darrin fail, Samantha goes to his cell with a suit of clothes. When Judge Crosetti hears Montague's mad account of a change of clothing in the cell, he releases Darrin. Larry Tate, having heard Barlow's equally wild story, decides his company is not interested in handling his account.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Dr. Passmore, psychiatrist at a rest home, tells Samantha his patients would like to do something to mark the Centennial of the End of the War Between the States. Samantha tells him Darrin will publicize the affair. Annoyed, Darrin tells Passmore Samantha will write a script for the pageant. Darrin criticizes Samantha's wooden characters. Taking Endora's advice, Samantha uses magic to bring her characters to life, so she can describe them. Soon Confederate Captain Corcoran, Violet, a beautiful Yankee, and an Indian, added for a neutral touch, are wandering around the Stephens' home. Seeing them, Gladys Kravitz flips. When Darrin arrives, the characters refuse to leave. How-ever, they vanish when Darrin kisses Samantha. Gladys tells her story to Passmore. He prescribes for her, but seeing the characters himself, decides he needs a vacation. When Samantha's writing comes to a halt, Corcoran, Violet and the Indian finish the script themselves and leave. After the pageant, Samantha is asked to create a vaudeville revue for the rest home. Two song and dance men appear. Gladys sees them and runs screaming into the night. Samantha tells Darrin she'll need lots of love to keep the hoofers away.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin is struggling to create an advertising campaign for a toy ship model manufactured by Mr. Herding. When Samantha wonders whether the Stephens ' baby will look like his father, Endora turns Darrin into an eight-year-old. Returned to normal, Darrin goes to his office. Samantha repeats a disparaging remark Darrin made about Endora. Piqued, Endora turns Darrin into a boy at his office. Mr. Harding sees Darrin and compli-ments Larry on hiring a child to devise a campaign for a toy. Samantha uses magic to return Darrin to normal size but is called on time after time to change him from man to boy when Harding insists on having a point meeting with Darrin and the boy. Finally, as a child, Darrin meets two boys who tell him the ship model is no good because it can't do anything. As Darrin, the man, persuades Harding and Larry to make the changes suggested by the two boys, Samantha gratefully produces a kite for each. When Darrin tells her he'd like to join them, Saman-tha replies he'll have his own son to play with soon.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Aunt Clara tells Samantha and Endora she is hiding from warlock Hedley Partridge, because she fears her old beau will discover her magic no longer works. Seeing in Hedley a husband for Aunt Clara, who has become a problem, Endora invites him to the Stephens home. Samantha decides to make sure Aunt Clara's tricks work. Unaware of this, Aunt Clara is sure her gift is returned when she matches all of Hedley's tricks. When Samantha goes out of the room, Aunt Clara tries to follow Hedley's ro-mantic suggestion that they turn themselves into nightingales, but Hedley becomes an animal, while Aunt Clara's lower half disappears. Gladys Kravitz, who has become hysterical watching the strange happenings, drags Abner over to the Stephens house. When Samantha returns Aunt Clara and Hedley to normal, Aunt Clara is crushed to learn that Samantha helped her all along. Gladys skeptically accepts Abner's explanation that Hedley's magic was performed with the aid of wires. Aunt Clara and Hedley each admit that none of their tricks work as well as they used to. Promising to return, Hedley leaves. Aunt Clara tells Samantha his parting gift a rhinestone doorknob, is more precious than an engagement ring.

Her jealous reaction convinces Darrin that Samantha really loves him. Darrin explains be thought she was posing as Barbara, but leaves Samantha with an uncertain feeling.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha's Aunt Clara arrives on the Stephens' first anniversary with presents for Samantha and Darrin. Casting a spell to adjust a checkered cap she has given Darrin, Aunt Clara uses the wrong words and turns Darrin into a chimpanzee. Unable to remember how to remove the spell, Aunt Clara goes home to look for the formula. When Samantha leaves the house, Endora stays with Darrin. Darrin leaps out of a window and runs into Gladys Kravitz. She takes the chimp back to her house. Soon after, Aunt Clara comes with her book of magic, Samantha returns. Samantha tells Aunt Clara she must find Darrin since her doctor has told her she is going to have a baby. Meanwhile, Gladys and Abner have turned Darrin over to the zoo, where he is caged with three other chimps. Samantha goes to the zoo. Then Aunt Clam arrives and turns Darrin back to his former self. Samantha is finally able to tell him he is to be a father. Later, Gladys begins telling the Stephens about the chimpanzee. Suddenly realizing that Darrin is wearing the same outfit as the chimp, Gladys streaks back to her own house.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Learning that he is about to become a father, Darrin waits on Samantha hand and foot. Then Larry Tate convinces him that all women would make a career out of having a baby if you allowed them to. He gives Darrin a book on the subject which states that the more active the mother, the happier she will be, and the healthier the child. Darrin returns home completely convinced. Endora is infuriated when she hears Darrin ordering Samantha to do chores around the house. The following day, Darrin wakes up with a backache. At an office lunch, he fights for extra pickles. When Samantha learns of this, she faces up to her mother. Endora admits she has cast a spell over Darrin, but will do nothing to change the situation for the present. Darrin, dis-cussing his plight at a bar, becomes obsessed with the idea that he is going to have a baby himself. Finally, Endora removes the spell and Darrin becomes completely attentive to Samantha once more. She agrees with Darrin's assertion that he is one man in a million who knows just how she feels.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: We'Re In For A Bad Spell
programme.desc: When strange things begin happening to Adam Newlarkin, a friend of Darrin's, Aunt Clara tells Samantha he has inherited the spell placed by a witch on his ancestor who was a judge in Salem two hundred years before. Aunt Clara adds that unless Adam follows the antidote for the spell strictly, he will be branded a thief. The Stephens learn that Adam has been hired by a local bank. Samantha and Darrin manage to get Adam to kiss a dog, the first step. With Aunt Clara's help, Darrin dunks Adam in a pool three times. They have trouble persuading him to ride through town shouting praise of witches, which is the final step. However, finding his briefcase stuffed with money , Adam, a true native of Salem, believes he is under a spell. He mounts a horse and starts riding. Bank manager Abercrombie and a detective, having discovered the loss of seventy five thousand dollars, come to the Stephens' home. Aunt Clara makes the money disappear from the briefcase. Abercrombie apologizes to Adam after learning that a bank employee has been taken into custody with the stolen cash.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Phoning from London, the Tates inform the Stephens that their governess has been taken ill. They ask Darrin and Samantha to care for the child until they return. Gladys Kravitz sees them leaving the house and returning with a baby. Assuming the Stephens' baby has arrived, Gladys congratulates Maurice, Samantha's father, on the birth of his grandson. Maurice is shocked to find the baby is not being taught witchcraft. He flies away with the child to the Warlock's Club in London. Meanwhile, the Tates arrive at the local airport. Darrin tries to stall while Samantha finds their baby. In London, after many tests, the Warlocks tell Maurice the baby "hasn't got it." Nanny Witch adds that the baby is a mortal like the father. At the Stephens home, Samantha and Darrin are about to tell the Tates their baby is missing, when Maurice arrives with the child. Maurice's pride is restored when Samantha tells him her baby is not due for several months. Arriving with a present, Gladys is told to wait until Samantha's baby is born. Before vanishing through a wall, Maurice hands Gladys a martini. Watching Gladys down it, Samantha hopes she will not remember what she has seen and heard.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha arranges a meeting between Darrin and her mother which she hopes will settle their differences. A series of minor accidents sets Darrin and Endora accusing each other of being practical pokers. Realizing someone else is responsible, Samantha uncovers a serving dish and reveals her Uncle Arthur, who dotes on practical jokes. Infuriated by Darrin's uproarious appreciation of Uncle Arthur, Endora plants a Beatles hairdo on Darrin. Darrin refuses Uncle Arthur's offer to teach him some magic so he can stand up to Endora, until he is knocked out by an accident in the office. Certain Endora is at work, Darrin accepts Uncle Arthur's offer. Following Uncle Arthur's weird instructions, Darrin tries to make Endora disappear. When she does not, Darrin realizes he has been the victim of another of Uncle Arthur's pranks. Samantha enlists Endora and Darrin in a plan to cure Uncle Arthur. Arthur is incredulous when Darrin says he can turn Endora into a parrot. When Endora becomes a parrot (through her own witchcraft), Arthur pleads with Darrin to remove the spell. Endora then returns to normal and demands that Arthur stop his practical jokes, which Uncle Arthur accepts. Before leaving, Uncle Arthur gives Endora a pair of opera glasses. When she lowers them she has two black eyes.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Take Two Aspirins And Half A Pint Of Porpoise Milk
programme.desc: While Howard Norton shows the Stephens a black Peruvian rose, Samantha tells Darrin she feels ill and has lost her witchcraft. The doctor tells Samantha that her health is perfect. Gladys sees the doctor's car and brings some chicken soup. When square green spots appear on Samantha's face, Abner is sure the chicken soup is responsible. Aunt Clara arrives and lists the ingredients for a remedy. Darrin buys all the ingre-dients, except an ostrich feather, from Mr. Trigby, who caters to witches. Trying to take the ostrich feather from a woman's hat, Darrin is arrested but later released. Aunt Clara, after using witchcraft to produce an ostrich, tells Darrin she still needs four petals from a black Peruvian rose. Darrin is arrested when he tries to steal the petals from Mr. Norton's precious bloom. Finally, Aunt Clara concocts the remedy and cures Samantha. Later, Mr. Norton is astonished when he sees a window box filled with black Peruvian roses Samantha has produced by twitching her nose.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Despite Endora's demand that Samantha accompany her to a witches celebration of Halloween, Darrin insists that his wife stay at home to entertain Louise and Larry Tate, Jack Rogers, a client, and his wife, Phyllis. Disguising herself as a child in a gypsy costume, Endora hexes Darrin with a spell that will gradually turn him into a werewolf. When Samantha demands that her mother remove the spell, Endora tells her she can't remember the words. After the guests arrive, Darrin is forced to go out of the room from time to time to shave off the werewolf hair which is beginning to grow all over him. Finally, when dinner arrives, Darrin starts snarling and jumps through as open window. Larry and Jack, sure that Darrin is in werewolf costume, bring him back into the house. Darrin, fearful of what he might do, gets Samantha to lock him in the call closet. Endora reappears in a high fashion evening gown. When Samantha tells her she is behaving exactly like the stereotype of a witch she hates so much, Endora returns Darrin to his normal self. Later, Jack, certain that Endora is also garbed for Halloween, compliments her on her bizarre outfit. Endora gestures, and a lion's tail appears on Jack. Endora tells Darrin Jack won't notice it until he tries to remove his trousers.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Larry Tate invites Samantha and Darrin to a buffet for prospective client Charles Barlow. When they complain about the condition of their clothes, Aunt Clara uses magic to produce a dress for Samantha and a new suit for Darrin, who invites her along to the affair. Once there, Aunt Clara removes a fire hydrant so Darrin can park. At the party, Samantha's dress begins to vanish and Aunt Clara's other magical efforts begin to disintegrate. Agreeing to drop Barlow at his hotel, Darrin finds the hydrant has returned to its place beside the car. As a policeman approaches, Darrin's outer garments disappear. Aunt Clara's efforts to help result in chaos, with Barlow, Darrin and the policeman dressed in each other's clothing. Barlow leaves, vowing Darrin will never get his account, and still in his underwear, Darrin is jailed with Montague, an alcoholic. After Aunt Clara's attempts to clothe Darrin fail, Samantha goes to his cell with a suit of clothes. When Judge Crosetti hears Montague's mad account of a change of clothing in the cell, he releases Darrin. Larry Tate, having heard Barlow's equally wild story, decides his company is not interested in handling his account.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Dr. Passmore, psychiatrist at a rest home, tells Samantha his patients would like to do something to mark the Centennial of the End of the War Between the States. Samantha tells him Darrin will publicize the affair. Annoyed, Darrin tells Passmore Samantha will write a script for the pageant. Darrin criticizes Samantha's wooden characters. Taking Endora's advice, Samantha uses magic to bring her characters to life, so she can describe them. Soon Confederate Captain Corcoran, Violet, a beautiful Yankee, and an Indian, added for a neutral touch, are wandering around the Stephens' home. Seeing them, Gladys Kravitz flips. When Darrin arrives, the characters refuse to leave. How-ever, they vanish when Darrin kisses Samantha. Gladys tells her story to Passmore. He prescribes for her, but seeing the characters himself, decides he needs a vacation. When Samantha's writing comes to a halt, Corcoran, Violet and the Indian finish the script themselves and leave. After the pageant, Samantha is asked to create a vaudeville revue for the rest home. Two song and dance men appear. Gladys sees them and runs screaming into the night. Samantha tells Darrin she'll need lots of love to keep the hoofers away.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin is struggling to create an advertising campaign for a toy ship model manufactured by Mr. Herding. When Samantha wonders whether the Stephens ' baby will look like his father, Endora turns Darrin into an eight-year-old. Returned to normal, Darrin goes to his office. Samantha repeats a disparaging remark Darrin made about Endora. Piqued, Endora turns Darrin into a boy at his office. Mr. Harding sees Darrin and compli-ments Larry on hiring a child to devise a campaign for a toy. Samantha uses magic to return Darrin to normal size but is called on time after time to change him from man to boy when Harding insists on having a point meeting with Darrin and the boy. Finally, as a child, Darrin meets two boys who tell him the ship model is no good because it can't do anything. As Darrin, the man, persuades Harding and Larry to make the changes suggested by the two boys, Samantha gratefully produces a kite for each. When Darrin tells her he'd like to join them, Saman-tha replies he'll have his own son to play with soon.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Aunt Clara tells Samantha and Endora she is hiding from warlock Hedley Partridge, because she fears her old beau will discover her magic no longer works. Seeing in Hedley a husband for Aunt Clara, who has become a problem, Endora invites him to the Stephens home. Samantha decides to make sure Aunt Clara's tricks work. Unaware of this, Aunt Clara is sure her gift is returned when she matches all of Hedley's tricks. When Samantha goes out of the room, Aunt Clara tries to follow Hedley's ro-mantic suggestion that they turn themselves into nightingales, but Hedley becomes an animal, while Aunt Clara's lower half disappears. Gladys Kravitz, who has become hysterical watching the strange happenings, drags Abner over to the Stephens house. When Samantha returns Aunt Clara and Hedley to normal, Aunt Clara is crushed to learn that Samantha helped her all along. Gladys skeptically accepts Abner's explanation that Hedley's magic was performed with the aid of wires. Aunt Clara and Hedley each admit that none of their tricks work as well as they used to. Promising to return, Hedley leaves. Aunt Clara tells Samantha his parting gift a rhinestone doorknob, is more precious than an engagement ring.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: After an argument, Gladys Kravitz locks her husband out of their home. The Stephens invite Abner to spend the night at their place. Later, when it appears that Abner, using all his privileges as a guest, is more than satisfied with the arrangements and is making no effort to return to his own home, Darrin demands that Samantha take action. Not only is Samantha unsuccessful in all her attempts to effect a reconciliation, but she learns that Gladys wants a divorce. When all else fails, Samantha gets the idea of using sleep therapy to reunite the Kravitzes. Feeling that one of the happiest days of her life is the day a man proposes marriage, and a woman accepts him, Samantha projects Gladys and Abner in their dreams back to that day. Then she awakens them and each begins looking for the other. Later, as Samantha and Darrin look forward to spending an evening at home alone, the Kravitzes arrive to celebrate their reunion.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: As Darrin naps in the living room, Endora points out some of the unfortunate details of his face. Samantha at first protests when her mother, using witchcraft, changes Darrin's looks but then adds some touches of her own. Awakening, Darrin demands an explanation. Samantha can't explain why she and Endora were changing his features, and Darrin begins to worry. As the obsession grows, Samantha decides to build up her husband's ego. Changing her own personality, Samantha becomes a French sculptress, Michelle. She tells Darrin his face exudes the masculine appeal she has always tried to find in a model. Darrin turns down Michelle's request that he pose for her, suspecting that she is Samantha. A substitute secretary, Barbara Lucas, appears at the office and Darrin, thinking it is another of Samantha's tricks, makes a play for her, just as Samantha walks in. Her jealous reaction convinces Darrin that Samantha really loves him. Darrin explains be thought she was posing as Barbara, but leaves Samantha with an uncertain feeling.

programme.desc: no info available

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin starter en krig, da hun lægger an på Justin lige foran Audrina. Spencer ser på huse med Heidi og køber et hus uden hendes godkendelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Da Audrina brænder Kristin af, beslutter hun sig for ikke at kæmpe imod sin tiltrækning af Justin. Heidi melder sig til at passe naboens barn, men Spencer vil ikke have noget med børn at gøre.

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får sin første forsmag på at være i et forhold med Justin, da han ikke dukker op til Brodys surprise party. Heidi og Spencer er uenige om, hvornår de skal starte en familie, og Audrina går på date med Justins bedste ven.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror, at hun har tæmmet Justin, men han har måske ikke glemt Audrina. Da Holly mister kontrollen til et event, må Heidi få sin søster til at konfrontere sit spiritusproblem.

programme.title: The Hills: Sorry Boo, Strike Two
programme.desc: Justin spiller kostbar med Kristin, men hans plan giver bagslag. Hollys druk fører til en intervention af Heidi og Stephanie. Brody og Jayde skændes og genovervejer deres forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Justin er ude på dybt vand efter Kristin og Audrina endelig mødes ansigt til ansigt. Heidi vil have en baby til sin fødselsdag, men Spencer har noget andet i tankerne.

programme.title: The Hills: On To The Next
programme.desc: Kristin og Brody overvejer at date igen, men et møde med Jayde viser, det ikke er tid. Audrina og Justin mødes for at diskutere deres fremtid, men det ender ikke, som hun havde håbet. Spencer tager drastiske tiltag mod Heidis babybesættelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.sub-title: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.desc: Kristin skændes med Jayde, fordi hun vil have Brody tilbage. Heidi planlægger at blive gravid med eller uden Spencers samtykke, Audrina må forholde sig til, at Justin stadig har følelser for Kristin.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. Right Now
programme.desc: Kristin vil ikke være sammen med Justin, men han lader hende ikke gå uden at kæmpe. Audrina ender alt med Justin for altid. Brody får kolde fødder, da Jayde vil flytte sammen, og Spencer frygter, at Heidi måske er gravid.

programme.title: The Hills: The Boys Of Summer
programme.desc: Kristin og Justin beslutter at tage deres forhold til det næste niveau og Spencer konfronterer Heidi om en graviditetstest. Brody har måske stadig følelser for Kristin, efter Jayde konfronterer ham om deres forhold til en forlovelsesfest.

programme.title: The Hills: Put On A Happy Face
programme.desc: Heidis hjemkomst bliver ødelagt, da hendes mor kritiserer hendes plastikoperation. Kristin og pigerne tagr til Miami til Super Bowl-weekend, men stemningen bliver dårlig, da hun fester så hårdt, at det bekymrer Audrina, Lo og Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Rumor Has It
programme.desc: Da rygterne går om Kristins partying får Stephanie skylden. Audrina begynder at date en ny fyr, men det stopper ikke Brody fra at prøve at score hende. Spencer bliver vred, da han møder Stephanie til Kristins fest.

programme.title: The Hills: The Elephant In The Room
programme.desc: Heidi arrangerer en fest for sin nabo, men den bliver overskygget af at Spencer flipper ud på Holly. Kristin opfordrer Audrina til at fokusere på Ryan, og prøver derefter at få et tættere forhold til Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: This Is Goodbye
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencers opførsel fører til, at deres venner og familie træffer et vanskeligt valg. Kristin og Brody kysser, men er enige om at fortsætte som singler. Ryan skuffer Audrina, da han ikke dukker op til en bytur.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird
programme.desc: Brody sætter sit venskab med Kristin på spil da han begynder at date en anden pige. Lo sender Stephanie ud på en dobbeldate. Ryan giver Audrinas venner en ny chance.

programme.title: The Hills: Ghost From The Past
programme.desc: Kristin slider med at komme videre efter Brody. Audrina møder Justin og begynder at tvivle på sit forhold til Ryan. Lo bliver venner med Brodys nye kæreste.

programme.title: The Hills: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: Brodys nye flamme lægger sig ud med Kristin da hun tager en af Kristins rivalr med til en fest. Ryan kommer tilbage fra turneen, men Audrina forteæler ham ikke, at hun mødtes med Justin mens han var borte.

programme.title: The Hills: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.sub-title: Between A Rocker And A Hard Place
programme.desc: Audrinas forhold til Ryan bliver sat på prøve, da han møder Justin for første gang. Brody er på Kristins side da Allie skændes med hende. Stephanie har en skuffende anden date.

programme.title: The Hills: Break-Up to Make-Up
programme.desc: Lige da Audrina afslutter tingene med Ryan, overrasker Justin hende på hendes fødselsdag. McKaelas ven Allie skaber flere problemer for Kristin. Brody fortæller Justin hvad han tænker.

programme.title: The Hills: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: På en surfertur til Costa Rica gør Kristin Brody jaloux ved at kysse med en lokal bartender, Audrina prøver at modstå den tiltrækning, hun føler til Justin, og Stephanie har det svæt i junglen.

programme.title: The Hills: Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Kristin har en åbenhjertig samtale med Brody fordi hun ønsker at give forholdet en ny chance. Heidis mor kommer til LA, i håbet om at de kan forsones. Lo og hendes kæreste fejrer jubilæum og Stephanie begynder at date en ny fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: All Good Things...
programme.desc: Kristin står overfor en vigtig beslutning, som også påvirker Brody. Audrina slår op med Justin. Lo ved ikke, om hun er klar til at tage det næste skridt med sin kæreste og Stephanie tror, at hun endelig har fundet lykken.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: Den ikoniske vennegruppe begynder på en frisk, da de vender tilbage til The Hills og ses for første gang i flere år. Der er nye udfordringer, gamle rivaliseringer og romantiske forviklinger da de indser, at fortiden ikke altid er fortiden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Not My Family
programme.desc: Stephanie prøver at reparere sit forhold til sin bror, Spencer, Mischa konfronterer Perez Hilton, der mobbede hende før i tiden. Gnisten mellem Audrina og Justin ulmer stadig, men Justin har også fået øje på en anden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.sub-title: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.desc: Audrina får en chokerende oplysning om Justin Bobby, der tvinger hende til at genoverveje sine motiver. Bølgerne går højt, da Spencer og Heidi overvejer deres forhold til Brody. Og Brandon Thomas holder et poolparty for sin mor.
